title: Device Fingerprinting Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Risk
metaDescription: Calculate your device fingerprinting risk score. Assess how easily websites can track you through browser and device fingerprinting techniques.
description: Evaluate your vulnerability to device fingerprinting attacks. This calculator assesses how uniquely identifiable your browser and device are to websites, helping you understand your tracking risk and take steps to improve your privacy.

formula: const browserRisk = { chrome: 20, firefox: 15, safari: 18, edge: 22, incognito: 5, other: 25 }; const resolutionRisk = { common: 10, uncommon: 20, unique: 35 }; const languageRisk = { common: 5, regional: 15, unique: 30 }; const timezoneRisk = { common: 5, regional: 10, unique: 20 }; const deviceRisk = { common: 10, mobile: 15, unique: 25 }; let baseRisk = browserRisk[browserType] + Math.min(pluginsEnabled * 0.8, 25) + resolutionRisk[screenResolution] + languageRisk[languageSettings] + timezoneRisk[timezoneUnique] + deviceRisk[deviceSpecs]; const protections = (canvasBlocking ? -15 : 0) + (webglBlocking ? -10 : 0) + (userAgentSpoofing ? -12 : 0); const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk + protections)); const uniquenessLevel = riskScore > 80 ? 'Highly Unique' : riskScore > 60 ? 'Very Trackable' : riskScore > 40 ? 'Moderately Trackable' : riskScore > 20 ? 'Low Risk' : 'Well Protected'; const protectionGrade = riskScore > 80 ? 'F' : riskScore > 70 ? 'D' : riskScore > 60 ? 'C' : riskScore > 40 ? 'B' : 'A'; const similarUsers = riskScore > 80 ? '1 in 10,000+' : riskScore > 60 ? '1 in 1,000-10,000' : riskScore > 40 ? '1 in 100-1,000' : riskScore > 20 ? '1 in 10-100' : '1 in 1-10'; return { riskScore, uniquenessLevel, protectionGrade, estimatedUsers: similarUsers };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your device fingerprinting risk by analyzing browser characteristics, device specifications, and protection measures. It considers factors like browser type, plugins, screen resolution, language settings, and active privacy protections to estimate how uniquely identifiable you are to tracking websites.
tips: Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser to reduce fingerprinting risk
Enable canvas and WebGL fingerprint blocking in your browser settings
Minimize the number of browser plugins and extensions you install
Consider using common screen resolutions and language settings
Regularly clear cookies and use private browsing modes
Use VPN services to mask your IP address and location data
Keep your browser updated but avoid beta or unusual versions
Disable JavaScript on sensitive sites where possible
